title: 94 acres in Massachusetts approved for 26 homes may become a $2 million wildlife conservation area
summary_full: In Gloucester, Massachusetts, a 26-home housing initiative is meeting resistance from environmental groups. The Essex County Greenbelt intends to purchase the 94-acre woodland to preserve the area's natural environment. Future objectives include establishing walking trails to connect this space with adjacent conservation properties. Though most funding is secured, necessary approvals from the local council are still pending, alongside the open wetlands application by the Conservation Commission.
